messages:
Maya (People Ops): Follow-up thread from today's all-hands re: the hiring plan, role pooling, and manager guidance. Filing answers here so managers have one place to reference.

Jonas (CTO): Quick summary: targeted Q3 additions focused on runtime, platform automation, and developer experience. Net +40 headcount goal; emphasis on senior infra hires.

Noor (ENG Manager - DevEx): Two quick Qs: 1) If a role becomes pooled, can my team still prioritize a candidate we like? 2) Whats the SLA for central placement?

Sahil (VP Eng): Yes, teams still interview and recommend. For POOL_* tags, central ops finalizes placement within 7 business days. To keep a pooled slot on your team submit a 2-sentence rationale to People Ops + Eng leadership.

Priya (Finance): Budget note: total headcount envelope unchanged. We can prioritize senior hires but need written justification for relocations or sign-on exceptions. Expect 3-5 business day turnaround for standard exceptions.

Elliot (Recruiter): Sourcing update: agencies and sourcers will focus on L4+ infra profiles starting Monday. Please add the tag `INFRA_Q3_SENIOR` to GH reqs and pre-fill interviewer panels to speed loops.

Maya (People Ops): Approval TL;DR: backfills that match an approved slot -> post within 3 business days and approve within 5. Rebands or new slots -> review up to 7 business days. For rush offers use the "expedite" label and DM me.

Noor (ENG Manager - DevEx): Onboarding question: can we get a short ramp checklist for L4-L5 hires?

Maya (People Ops): Will post full checklist to handbook. Short snippet: Week1: access & buddy; Week2: pairing task; Weeks3-4: infra deep-dive; Weeks5-8: own a small project + 1:1s.

Sahil (VP Eng): Interviewing guidance: managers should attend at least one of the first 3 interviews. We added a "scale scenario" prompt to infra take-homes and a scorecard line for "systems thinking."

Maya (People Ops): I'll publish a one-page playbook with pool tags, approval SLAs, scorecard note, and onboarding link by tomorrow morning. hr-bot will post the doc link here when live.

hr-bot: New doc posted -> https://handbook.redwood.ai/hiring/q3-next-steps (doc id: 1313)

Noor (ENG Manager - DevEx): Thanks  very helpful. Will queue reqs and panels today.

Elliot (Recruiter): Adding calibration session Fri 10am PT for hiring managers. Invite incoming.

Maya (People Ops): Closing the loop  DM me if anything urgent. :white_check_mark:
